en: Now, throughout this module, we've seen a
lot of algorithms and especially in the last
module, in the previous module, we also saw
some algorithms that probably are a bit
harder to wrap your head around, that are a
bit harder to digest.
And that certainly can be intimidating
because after all, you're taking a course
like this to have an easier time solving
solving problems and finding algorithms or
coming up with algorithms, for example, in
interview situations. That's why in this
module, we'll explore a more structured
problem-solving approach
and I will show you how you can solve any
problem and how you can become a true master
of algorithms. Now for that, I'll share some
ideas on how to approach problems and how to
come up with solutions and we'll see more
examples and apply such a problem-solving
approach
to, well, eventually solve any kind of
problem and become a true algorithm master.
